WYLDER_WINDWARD_STANCE_POWER.description:
Eligibility begins when this Power is deployed.
Reentry qualifies; Block follows card effects and the old Pursuit draw.
WYLDER_BATTLE_INSTINCT_POWER.title: Battle Instinct
WYLDER_BATTLE_INSTINCT_POWER.description:
Only Attacks actually played from hand qualify, including hand autoplay but not external replays.
Check for the single Skill after all related draws; failed conditions do not spend eligibility.
WYLDER_BLOOD_STILL_HOT_POWER.title: Blood Still Hot
WYLDER_BLOOD_STILL_HOT_POWER.description:
The first actual Vigor gain counts card and Power sources, including gains before deployment.
Enemy-turn gains do not count; rewards inside attacks wait until the whole card finishes.
WYLDER_FLAME_GUARD_STANCE_POWER.title: Flame Guard Stance
WYLDER_FLAME_GUARD_STANCE_POWER.descript:
Only Vigor actually consumed by the native attack counts, not direct Skill losses.
New Pursuit is granted after the whole card and cannot enhance its remaining hits.
WYLDER_PURSUIT_COMMAND_POWER.title: Pursuit Command
WYLDER_PURSUIT_COMMAND_POWER.description:
Only a card's direct entry or reentry into Pursuit counts, not Powers or Relics.
The first such entry counts even before deployment; all copies together draw at most 2 cards per turn.
WYLDER_BATTLEFIELD_MIGHT_POWER.title: Battlefield Might
WYLDER_BATTLEFIELD_MIGHT_POWER.descripti:
The first successful Break counts across the whole turn; kills still reward.
Strength is granted after the whole attack and cannot boost its remaining hits.
WYLDER_GUARD_RESURGENCE_POWER.title: Guard Resurgence
WYLDER_GUARD_RESURGENCE_POWER.descriptio:
Only a Skill's successful Stun qualifies, including Parry autoplayed from hand.
The reward snapshots copies at trigger time and is paid after next turn's base resources initialize.
WYLDER_SWIFT_BATTLE_WILL_POWER.title: Swift Battle Will
WYLDER_SWIFT_BATTLE_WILL_POWER.descripti:
The first qualifying settlement counts even before deployment.
Every Swift Battle Will card and every external replay is excluded.
The check occurs after all Pursuit and related Power draws.
WYLDER_RUINOUS_GHOSTFLAME_POWER.title: Ruinous Ghostflame
WYLDER_RUINOUS_GHOSTFLAME_POWER.descript:
Whenever an attack hit deals more than 20 damage to an enemy, apply 2 [gold]Freeze[/gold] (3 when upgraded).
Check each hit separately before Block.
WYLDER_PURSUIT_STANCE_POWER.title: Pursuit Stance
WYLDER_PURSUIT_STANCE_POWER.description:
Consumes the old Pursuit eligibility even if the status instance survives reentry.
Power cards spend the first-consumption opportunity without an Attack or Skill reward.
All copies grant at most 1 Energy or 20 base Block, with Dexterity applied once.
WYLDER_FIERY_BLOOD_POWER.title: Fiery Blood
WYLDER_FIERY_BLOOD_POWER.description:
Only actual Vigor gained directly by a card counts.
Eligibility is locked before this Power's extra gain; indirect Power gains cannot trigger it recursively.
WYLDER_VETERAN_EDGE_POWER.title: Veteran Edge
WYLDER_VETERAN_EDGE_POWER.description: Whenever you trigger [gold]Break[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] per stack.
WYLDER_UNYIELDING_SPIRIT_POWER.title: Unyielding Spirit
WYLDER_UNYIELDING_SPIRIT_POWER.descripti:
Resets at the start of each player turn.
Block is granted immediately after the first enemy hit that causes HP loss, protecting later hits but not undoing damage already taken.
WYLDER_NIGHT_EDGE_POWER.title: Night Edge
WYLDER_NIGHT_EDGE_POWER.description:
The first Attack with Break counts across the turn, including autoplay, replay and attacks before deployment; failure still spends its threshold reduction.
The first successful Break is independent and awards Vigor after the whole card.
Use the strongest threshold reduction and Vigor reward across copies, not their sum.
WYLDER_BOLDNESS_POWER.title: Boldness
WYLDER_BOLDNESS_POWER.description: When an attack hit deals more than 20 damage before Block, gain 5 Block (7 when upgraded).
WYLDER_NIGHT_FORM_POWER.title: Night Form
WYLDER_NIGHT_FORM_POWER.description:
Double the effects of [gold]Pursuit[/gold].
Pursuit grants 100% bonus attack damage, or 2 Energy and 2 cards when you play a Skill.
WYLDER_REMAINING_EMBER_POWER.title: Remaining Ember
WYLDER_REMAINING_EMBER_POWER.description: Whenever you enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold], add 1 [gold]Fire Coating[/gold] to your hand per stack (upgraded stacks add [gold]Fire Coating+[/gold]).
WYLDER_UNDYING_POWER.title: Undying
WYLDER_UNDYING_POWER.description: When [gold]Vigor[/gold] triggers, keep half its stacks.
WYLDER_ERUPTION_POWER.title: Eruption
WYLDER_ERUPTION_POWER.description: Whenever you trigger [gold]Break[/gold], deal 7 damage to ALL enemies (9 when upgraded).
WYLDER_WILDFIRE_POWER.title: Spreading Wildfire
WYLDER_WILDFIRE_POWER.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Vigor[/gold], deal damage equal to the stacks gained to a random enemy.
